root_cause: The deploy build replaces original index/product HTML with a V18 canonical shared shell; legacy CSS in assets/kop.css does not style the active v17-header. Fixed promotional overlay and unbounded mobile headline remained active.

actions: Apply rules to the active v17-header via canonical components.mjs.
Disable large trustbar only at phone widths.
Remove opaque H1 marker background on phones.
Project the overlay cleanup in final Netlify build stage for generated pages.

evidence.review: Customer-supplied iPhone screenshots reviewed against live homepage and /product

historical_screenshots.observation: Mobile title overflows and yellow marker blocks cover text
Header/hero oversized, timed cost overlay blocks content
